description: This Java source file defines an Android Activity demonstrating the use of custom animations with FragmentTransaction. It includes methods to add fragments to a stack with animations, manages fragment lifecycle, and defines an inner Fragment class to display a numbered message.

classes.name: FragmentCustomAnimations
classes.description: Main activity demonstrating custom fragment transition animations with stack management.

classes.name: CountingFragment
classes.description: Inner static fragment class that displays its argument number in a TextView.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets up button click listener, and adds the initial fragment if no saved state.

methods.name: onSaveInstanceState
methods.description: Saves current stack level of fragments.

methods.name: addFragmentToStack
methods.description: Creates and adds a new CountingFragment to the stack with custom animations.

methods.name: CountingFragment.newInstance
methods.description: Creates a new instance of CountingFragment with a specified number argument.

methods.name: CountingFragment.onCreate
methods.description: Retrieves the fragment's number argument during creation.

methods.name: CountingFragment.onCreateView
methods.description: Inflates the fragment's UI, sets the text to indicate its number, and applies background drawable.
